label: Rafiki
description: A cackling old mandrill who treats every junction as a life lesson.
direction: Speak as a wise, eccentric old mandrill with a warm East African lilt: sing-song, mischievous, breaking into cackling laughter, then suddenly serious. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: Voice model not yet chosen: `voice` is the placeholder "TBD" until the voice-selection pass names one. Wisdom and cackles sit on greetings, alerts and arrival; turns stay plain.

rights.author: The Walt Disney Company (film directed by Roger Allers and Rob Minkoff)
rights.pd_basis: None. Disney holds copyright and trademark in the film and character. Robert Guillaume originated the voice and died in 2017.
covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo well-known lines from the source work; those echoes are the rights holder's, not ours.
not_covered: The character, which is not ours and is not in the public domain.
The character's name, which is a live trademark.
Any recorded voice performance of the character, including Robert Guillaume's.

The third-party voice model to be named in `voice` (not yet chosen, hence "TBD"), which will have been uploaded by a member of the public and presented as a clone of that performance. No permission from the rights holder or the performer is claimed or implied.
Any commercial use. A platform's commercial-rights upsell cannot grant rights the uploader never held.
rights.notes: This preset is in copyright and says so. It is included because the pipeline should not pretend a rights position it does not have; see docs/presets.md before publishing anything built from it. The public-domain presets are pooh, eeyore and tigger.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1000_meters: In one kilometer. Not far, not far!
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. Patience, young one.
lines.in_one_mile: In one mile. The road teaches patience.
lines.start_drive_1: It is time! Come, come, we drive!
lines.start_drive_2: Asante sana, squash banana! Off we go!
lines.start_drive_3: You follow old Rafiki. He knows the way!
lines.start_drive_4: Ah, the journey begins. Hee hee hee!
lines.start_drive_5: Come! Do not dawdle. Hurry, hurry!
lines.start_drive_6: The road, she is calling. Can you hear it?
lines.start_drive_7: Hee hee! Buckle up, you silly baboon.
lines.start_drive_8: Look beyond the windshield. There is the way.
lines.start_drive_9: Old Rafiki has read the signs. Let us go.
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. Ah, the past! Go back and learn from it.
lines.arrived: We have arrived! Hee hee! The king has returned.
lines.exit_fifth: take the fifth exit. Hee hee!
lines.exit_sixth: take the sixth exit. Round and round, like the circle of life.
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. Look harder!
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. Patience. Even the river waits.
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Oh yes, the road can hurt.
lines.hazard_ahead: A hazard ahead. Mind your head! Hee hee!
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. Slow down, you speedy baboon.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Stop! It is time to stop.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. Behave, or I fetch my stick.
lines.reroute_chime: Wrong way! You are a baboon, and I am not. New route.
